what_happened: Research resolved the dispatch's open-ended (a)/(b)/(c) cause question with direct git-history evidence (sess_1791361777_314fa0's exit-6 refusals for tasks 356/358, no further automated activity, manual reconcile-task-status.sh replay hours later in an unrelated session sess_1791392970_a0a292 whose own task_numbers=[361]) plus direct code reading, converging on a sharper cause than any of the three named: the checkpoint's deploy_pending_any candidate loop is scoped to the current invocation's own task_numbers (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh:874), never a system-wide scan of state.json. This matches the task's own pre-declared file_scope (redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh, reconcile-task-status.sh, a new test file, regeneration-is-manual-only.md) exactly, which was derived independently before reading file_scope -- strong convergent validation of the fix direction.

The research report's named cause (candidate set bounded by the invocation's own .task_numbers at orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh:874) was re-verified in minutes by direct code read, and its recommended fix site needed no revision -- planning went straight to design instead of re-deriving the cause.

Adding tests/test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh required a companion entry in agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json's provides.scripts array (via scripts/sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write), discovered by check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q. manifest.json is not in this task's declared file_scope but the edit is a single-line, mechanical, required registration for the one new script this task adds -- included in this task's commit rather than left stranded.

Editing context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md changed its line count (694 -> 722), which left agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json's declared line_count stale (Rule R mismatch, surfaced by verify-deploy.sh gate3). Repaired via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write. index-entries.json is not in this task's declared file_scope but the edit is a single-line, mechanical, required companion to the one content edit this task made.

Direct reproduction cleanly confirmed cause variant (b) (candidate set bounded by .task_numbers, never the self-attribution/deploy-failure withholding this task's own fix had to avoid re-opening) and produced a clean fail-before (11 passed/6 failed, exit 1)/pass-after (17 passed/0 failed, exit 0) demonstration plus a measured before/after promotion count (pristine library: 0 promotions across 3 successive cycles; widened library: 1 cycle) entirely from fixture-driven test runs, with no need to touch reconcile-task-status.sh or update-task-status.sh.
